WITH target_tenants AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM tenants
  WHERE industry ILIKE '%industrial%'
     OR industry ILIKE '%office equipment%'
     OR industry ILIKE '%wholesal%'
),
new_business_pipelines AS (
  SELECT id, tenant_id
  FROM pipelines
  WHERE name = 'New business'
),
base_opportunities AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN new_business_pipelines p
    ON o.pipeline_id = p.id
   AND o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
  WHERE o.tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_tenants)
    AND o.is_closed = true
),
opp_with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    bo.*,
    (
      SELECT er.rate
      FROM exchange_rates er
      WHERE er.base_code = 'EUR'
        AND er.quote_code = bo.currency_code
        AND er.as_of <= date(bo.closed_at)
      ORDER BY er.as_of DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS eur_rate
  FROM base_opportunities bo
),
activities_before_close AS (
  SELECT
    a.opportunity_id,
    count(*) AS activity_count
  FROM activities a
  JOIN base_opportunities bo
    ON a.opportunity_id = bo.id
   AND a.tenant_id = bo.tenant_id
  WHERE a.occurred_at <= bo.closed_at
  GROUP BY a.opportunity_id
),
opp_final AS (
  SELECT
    owr.id,
    owr.account_id,
    owr.owner_user_id,
    owr.is_won,
    owr.amount / owr.eur_rate AS amount_eur,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (owr.closed_at - owr.created_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_open,
    COALESCE(ac.activity_count, 0) AS activity_count
  FROM opp_with_rate owr
  LEFT JOIN activities_before_close ac
    ON ac.opportunity_id = owr.id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN is_won THEN 'won' ELSE 'lost' END AS outcome,
  count(*) AS opportunities,
  round(avg(amount_eur)::numeric, 2) AS avg_amount_eur,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount_eur)::numeric, 2) AS median_amount_eur,
  round(avg(activity_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_activities_before_close,
  round(avg(days_open)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days_open,
  count(DISTINCT account_id) AS distinct_accounts,
  count(DISTINCT owner_user_id) AS distinct_reps
FROM opp_final
GROUP BY is_won
ORDER BY CASE WHEN is_won THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
note: Restricted to pipelines named 'New business' (joined on pipelines.name) as requested, excluding Renewals; all other filters (tenant industry, is_closed) and conversions (EUR via nearest prior-day exchange rate) match the prior report's methodology.
